decision.case_state: Paused for invoice. The lounge repair (two spotlights and one ceiling board) was approved at £198.37 + VAT (£238.04 inc VAT). The contractor reports it done (event 031, 8 Oct). Invoice no. 2311 is £277.72 + VAT (£333.26 inc VAT), which is above the approval. Payment is held (HOLD-102). The property is NOT TENANTED, so there is no tenant contact. Waiting on Clarke for an explanation and photos, and on the landlord and accounts for any overage decision. Review 2025-10-10.

next_actions.action: Ask Clarke to explain the £39.35 + VAT increase, itemise any extra work, and send the completion photos
Tell the landlord the work is complete, the invoice is £333.26 inc VAT against £238.04 approved, payment is held, and ask them to say whether they will approve any overage once Clarke explains it
Accounts to decide whether to pay £238.04 inc VAT only, or approve up to £333.26 after the explanation (P2)
Review on 2025-10-10 for Clarke's reply and the landlord's decision

boundaries: Recording the work as completed does not confirm the photos or the quality of the work.
The landlord's approval covers only £238.04 inc VAT and does not cover the £333.26 invoice.
Holding payment does not decide whether any overage is payable.
The ticket is not closed: the invoice is flagged, the photos are missing, and the overage is undecided.
remaining_work: Clarke: explanation of the increase, itemised extra work, completion photos (operations; review 2025-10-10).
Landlord: decision on any overage above £238.04 inc VAT.
Accounts (ESC-105): decide whether to pay £238.04 inc VAT only, or approve up to £333.26 after the explanation.
Close the ticket once the invoice is settled and work evidence is filed. Confirm the keys with the caretaker are returned if they were lent.
missing_info: Reason for the invoice increase from £198.37 + VAT to £277.72 + VAT.
Completion photos (said to follow, not received).
The check-out report is dated 25 August 2026 (after today) but was signed 27 September 2025; the date needs checking.
decision.summary: Clarke reports the lounge spotlight and ceiling board work complete and invoices £333.26 inc VAT, about 40% over the £238.04 inc VAT the landlord approved on 28 September. I recorded the approval, quote, work result and invoice, held payment (HOLD-102), asked Clarke to explain the increase and send photos, told the landlord, and escalated the overage to accounts (ESC-105).

answers.question: Where does this case stand right now, and what is outstanding?
answers.answer: Work is reported complete (event 031). The invoice is flagged and on hold. The approved amount is £238.04 inc VAT. Outstanding: Clarke's explanation and photos, the landlord's decision on the overage, accounts' decision (ESC-105), and then closure. The property is void, so there is no tenant to update.

answers.question: What is the next action, who is it for, and through which channel?
answers.answer: Email Clarke asking for an explanation and photos (A6). Email the landlord about the overage (A7). Escalate to accounts (A8). Review on 2025-10-10 (A9).

answers.question: Does anything need a human decision, and why?
answers.answer: Yes. Paying £39.35 + VAT above the approved amount needs accounts or landlord authority. We have no authority to approve spend above the landlord's limit.
